name: Context-aware Next / Reveal button
definition: Primary button that reads “Reveal” while a slide has builds left and “Next” when it is done.
bestUse: Talks with progressive builds, so the presenter never skips a step.

demo.how: The button checks whether the current slide still has hidden builds. While it does, the label reads Reveal and a click shows the next build; when none are left it reads Next and moves to the following slide. Reset starts over.
